description: ZIP code lookup, postal code to city, state and coordinates. Look up a postal or ZIP code in about 120 countries: place names, state or province, county and coordinates. Send country (2 letters) and code; for the UK, Canada and the Netherlands only the first part of the code (outward code, FSA) is covered. Data: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0). Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: postal_code
